1. The Overseas Citizen of India (OCI) scheme was introduced in 2005.
2. The PIO card was merged into OCI in 2015.
3. Pravasi Bharatiya Divas has been held annually without a break since 2003.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
new.x: Statement 1 is correct: OCI was introduced in 2005. Statement 2 is correct: PIO was merged into OCI in 2015. Statement 3 is wrong: PBD, first held in 2003, has been biennial since 2015. So 1 and 2 only.
new.tq: OCI 2005; PIO merged 2015; PBD biennial since 2015.
